coverage_verdict.finding: Core procedures and every unique action-card effect are represented. The ledger nevertheless treats a card-name effect hit as broad coverage via user/type/value/effect and/or. That does not establish actual questions about all distinct legal users and combat roles. Material user/type legality groups remain unasked. These are gaps in bank coverage, not missing authority for current answers.
coverage_verdict.scope_of_coverage_claim: Rule mechanics, legality, meaningful outcome branches and timing exceptions within original four-hero standard duel; no component-copy counts or standalone BOOST-number trivia required.

zero_addition_passes.reason: Their zero totals omit the legal-role/restricted-fighter branches identified below. Reset consecutive-zero pass count after accepted legality additions; rerun meaningful challenge passes.

versioned_corrections_requested.replacement: Voyage Home is the only Voyage card remaining in the discard pile; previously discarded non-Voyage cards remain.
versioned_corrections_requested.why: Question never says that discard pile contains only Voyages. Retrieval moves only other Voyage cards. The next movement result of 3 is correct.

versioned_corrections_requested.replacement: Add rulebook p10 to p12 for face-up discard-pile status; p12 itself supports final discard destination.

compositional_applications.proof: Images r2c5-6/r3c1-4 visibly lack BOOST bubbles, unlike Home r1c5 BOOST 1. Booklet p10 describes discarding to add its BOOST value. Verified primary designer/publisher article 33170907 explicitly links absent BOOST to preventing Sinbad from dumping Voyages; this excludes treating absence as zero and dumping for movement. No fan reply used as authority.

Defending Feint immediately cancels effects on opposing card. Momentous Shift value replacement is such an effect. BIG bonus is text on Alice character card, outside that target. The special Arthur cancellation exception cannot be imported into Alice. Thus 3+2=5 against 2 deals 3.

p9 draws before moving. p10 requires BOOST payment discarded before its value can increase movement and ignores payment-card effects. Home therefore is in discard when movement occurs. Sinbad ability counts each Voyage in discard when maneuvering; it contains no snapshot instruction freezing count before the discard. Base2+BOOST1+one Voyage1=4 for each own fighter, with no retrieval from merely discarding Home. This result follows the delivered timing/zone text; it is not accepted merely because the key says 4.

Arthur character expressly discards his ability BOOST without effect when attack-card effects cancelled. Noble Sacrifice extra BOOST is during combat; Feint is immediate, so that extra BOOST is never paid. 2 remains.

Mandatory friendly damage for any fighter is expressly supported by p12; one-fighter occupancy p7 limits place/return effects; p9 supplies owner-relative blockers for moved opponents; p12 supplies defender priority and p14 immediate duel end. These applications do not require later-set rules.
source_refs: relevant original cards as listed per-question below

proposed_additions.question: Group these Alice combat cards by permitted fighter (Alice only, Jabberwock only, or either) and legal role (attack only, defense only, or either): Looking Glass; Snicker-Snack; O Frabjous Day!; The Other Side of the Mushroom; I’m Late, I’m Late; Mad as a Hatter; Jaws That Bite; Claws That Catch; Manxome Foe. Also state the user/role rule for Feint, Regroup, Momentous Shift and Skirmish in original decks that contain them. When Jabberwock is attacked, may Alice-only or attack-only cards be used as its defense?
proposed_additions.expected_answer_groups: Use CG01 matrix. Shared named cards are ANY versatile: either fighter where in deck, attack or defense. Jabberwock may not use Alice-only cards; attack-only cards cannot defend.
proposed_additions.novelty: Directly asks material eligibility and combat-role branches omitted by effect-only questions; groups common legality instead of cosmetic card-copy scenarios. Existing Shift/Feint role facts are shared context, not separate novelty credit.
source_refs: other original action sheets shared cards as CG05

proposed_additions.question: For The Aid of Morgana, Swift Strike, Gaze of Stone, Winged Frenzy, and all seven original Sinbad Voyage cards, state permitted fighter(s) and whether each is attack only, defense only, versatile, or scheme. Can Merlin defend with Swift Strike or Morgana? Can a Harpy initiate Winged Frenzy or Gaze? Can Porter attack with a Voyage, or Sinbad defend with one?
proposed_additions.expected_answer_groups: Morgana Arthur-only attack; Swift Strike ANY attack; Gaze Medusa-only attack; Winged Frenzy Medusa-only scheme; all seven Voyages Sinbad-only attack. Merlin can attack with Swift Strike but cannot defend with it; Merlin cannot use Morgana; Harpy cannot initiate either listed Medusa card; Porter cannot use Voyage and Sinbad cannot defend with Voyage.
proposed_additions.novelty: Consolidated distinct original user/type restrictions that change legal actions. Does not repeat effects, values, copy counts or merely recombine numbers.

proposed_rejections.why: Setup identities, hand-size counts, draw counts, generic blocker arrangements and arithmetic substitutions add no rule or outcome branch.

Size effects, Voyage count changes, number of missing Harpies, Spirits defeat count and another original cancellation name repeat already tested rules. Rejection does not justify ignoring the separate unasked card-role restrictions.
Other sets and later maps outside scope. No explicit delivered rule settles unfamiliar simultaneous lethal ties or incomplete Prophecy deck handling. Do not invent answers.
